Home/Preschool/Logic Adventures/13. Panda’s Missing Puzzle
PLAY · MISSING PIECES

Panda’s Missing Puzzle

Each picture is missing a piece! Circle the piece that completes it.

HOW TO DO IT

Read, then draw.

Each picture is missing a piece! Circle the piece that completes it.

It fits!

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear appear right here and work straight on the picture. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This adventure is cleared for you the moment you save your finished picture. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! All puzzles complete! Your saved work is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in the library.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This activity trains missing pieces right on the puzzle picture: one short written instruction, then real pencil work — circling, crossing, tracing and connecting on the illustration itself. Nothing is graded. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud while they draw — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Illustration note: The Canva title reads "Panda’s Mising Puzzle" — a missing S. The site always shows the corrected spelling; the artwork itself is reported for regeneration.

Prefer paper? The Panda’s Missing Puzzle worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
